div.head: Hn Lond 9
div.ab: Et husting sedeat semel in ebdomada, uidelicet die Lune.
Et husting sedeat semel in ebdomada, videlicet die Lunae.
And the husting shall sit once a week, namely on Monday.
div.note: Added October 2026 from Robertson pp. 290–291 (text and translation); Liebermann’s text added from Gesetze I p. 525, October 2026 (two independent readings of the page images)

note.seg: -tengum Horn Cus Cust El E IV
-tengum Horn Cus Cust El E IV
Indem der Freibrief 1155 dies wiederholt, lässt er den auch sonst oft bezeugten Wochentag fort. [Montag tagt auch Stangengericht zu Zürich; freundl. Mitt. von U. Stutz]
In repeating this, the charter of 1155 omits the day of the week, which is often attested elsewhere too. [The Stangengericht at Zürich also sits on Monday; kindly communicated by U. Stutz]

tantum wird ebd. zugefügt: hier wie Hn com 1. 2 hatte der königliche Gerichtsvogt aus fiskalischen oder eigensüchtigen Gründen öfter Gericht gehalten, um von Ausbleibenden Strafgeld zu erhalten. Im 13./14. Jh. hustengus tenetur de quindena in quindenam; Mun. Gildh. I 86. II 334

tantum is added ibid.: here, as in Hn com 1. 2, the king’s judicial officer had held court more often, for fiscal or self-interested reasons, in order to obtain fines from those who failed to attend. In the 13th/14th cent. hustengus tenetur de quindena in quindenam; Mun. Gildh. I 86. II 334
